title: Dechorionation of zebrafish embryos with Pronase for metronidazole-mediated β-cell ablation
author: Sandra Rieger
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8exhtfn

steps.title: Prepare Pronase working solution
steps.instruction: Add 9 ml of embryo medium containing 0.003 % PTU to a 15 ml Falcon tube that already contains 1 ml of the Pronase stock solution, mixing to obtain a 10 ml working solution at a concentration of 1 mg/ml.

steps.title: Incubate embryos to soften chorion
steps.instruction: Pour the 10 ml Pronase working solution into a small petri dish, place the embryos (still in their chorions) into the solution, and gently swirl the embryos until the chorion becomes soft (typically after 3–5 minutes for 24 hpf embryos; up to 10 minutes for 48 hpf larvae).

steps.title: Remove softened chorion
steps.instruction: Using forceps under a stereomicroscope, tear off the softened chorion from each embryo.

steps.title: Transfer and wash embryos
steps.instruction: Immediately transfer the dechorionated embryos into a petri dish containing fresh embryo medium, then wash the embryos three times with fresh embryo medium.
